heading: Thursday, November 27, 2025
topLine: DeepSeek releases DeepSeekMath-V2 open math reasoning model.

items.headline: DeepSeek releases DeepSeekMath-V2 open math reasoning model
items.summary: DeepSeekMath-V2 is an open-weight mathematical reasoning model built on DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp-Base that uses a proof generator with a separate verifier. DeepSeek reports gold-level performance on IMO 2025 problems and 118/120 on Putnam 2024.
